page_notes.34: 2-4: Standard Lift Workstation Kit Q-102129 (15) extracted; Lift Workstation with Flow Rack Q-102130 skipped (badged 40 metric + P, not 15).
page_notes.35: 2-5: Lift Workstation with Pegboard Q-106098 and Lift Workstation with Magnetic Dry Erase Board Q-106099 (both 15) extracted as kits.
page_notes.36: 2-6: Stationary Workstation with Pegboard Q-106100 and Stationary Workstation with Shelves Q-106101 (both 15) extracted as kits.
page_notes.37: 2-7: Stationary Workstation with Flow Rack Q-106102 (15) extracted as a kit.
page_notes.38: 2-8: Ready-Made Machine Guarding: mounting posts 24884/24885/24886 (15) and mesh panels 241082-245882 (F+M) extracted; Mounting Hardware table (24101, 24221, 24331) attached as suggested_hardware to the posts and panels.
page_notes.40: 2-10: Guarding Post with Control Panel 24900 (15) extracted; Mounting Hardware Included and Suggested Hardware (24331) tables attached to it as suggested_hardware.
page_notes.51: 2-21: Mobile Cart with Monitor Mount Q-106104 (15) extracted; Mobile Cart with Foldable Extensions Q-106103 skipped (10 series only).
page_notes.52: 2-22: Mobile Display with Magnetic Dry Erase Board Q-105781 (15) extracted as a kit.

corrected: Q-102129: specs.Frame Series "15" -> removed (badge column already captured in series; matches the other kits)
Q-106101: description "under-surface shelf openings" -> "18.00” x 18.00” x 27.00” shelf openings" (placement not stated in text)
remaining_doubts: 2-8 Mounting Hardware table (24221, 24101, 24331, each badged 15, Qty 1) was treated as a fasteners-required table and attached as suggested_hardware to the posts and mesh panels instead of being extracted as standalone parts; 24221 and 24331 appear in no other raw chunk as standalone parts (24101 is in c025, p. 4-173).

2-8: the post descriptions (Thru Hole / Tapped / No Machining) appear to pair with the Thru Bolt & Nut 24221 / Tap & Bolt 24101 / Bolt & T-Nut 24331 methods, but the page does not state this, so all three methods stay attached to every post and panel.
24900: printed weight 26.860 lb is paired with (4.962 kg), the same kg value as the 10.940 lb posts; kept verbatim (catalog error likely).

Text layer for 2-10 (24900 description, suggested-hardware description) and 2-21 (Q-106104 bullets, Shelf Openings header, T-Slot Finish values) is garbled or missing; those values were confirmed from the page image.
